capabilities: Draws a 12-hour spiral timeline of the day
Schedules to-dos into free gaps by list order and estimate
Shows planned time, spare or overload, and remaining capacity
Times DOING tasks and writes Pomodoro sessions back to the note
Reviews plan versus actual and estimate calibration
extras: Interface switches between English and Chinese based on Obsidian's language setting; detailed usage instructions live in an external user guide; click and status-change sounds can be muted in settings.
problem: Daily notes hold events and to-dos as plain text, with no view of whether the day's work actually fits the hours available.

relations.evidence: Pair it with Agent Deck and your daily note becomes a live dashboard for all your AI agents
Optionally pull events from macOS Calendar or Google Calendar into the spiral as fixed blocks

summary: Spiral day planner that pins fixed events from the daily note and flows to-dos into free gaps, with Pomodoro timing and AI session logging.
